title: Homemade Potato Gnocchi
subtitle: with a Mediterranean sauce
description: Oven-baked potato gnocchi made at home, pan-fried and finished with a Mediterranean sauce of tomato, artichoke and olives.

steps.text: For the gnocchi: preheat the oven to 250°C.
Bake the potatoes in their skins on a bed of coarse salt until soft and dry (at least an hour).
Scoop out the potato flesh and mash until smooth, then weigh it (you need 500 g). Add the egg yolk and salt, then gradually add the flour.
Mix into an even dough and cut into small pieces about 5 cm.
On a floured surface roll the pieces into long thin ropes and cut into gnocchi about 1 cm long with a scraper or lightly floured knife. Arrange on a floured baking tray.
To cook: boil salted water in a large pot and cook the gnocchi until they float, then another half minute.
Lift the gnocchi out with a slotted spoon and pan-fry in a hot pan with olive oil until golden.
For the Mediterranean sauce: add the tomatoes, artichoke, olives and garlic to the pan and toss briefly. Add dry white wine and cook until all the liquid has evaporated.
Add the herbs and salt and toss, then pour in the lemon juice, mix and serve.
